title: scanpy-advanced input schema
description: JSON schema for params.json passed to scanpy-advanced.py via BioF3 dispatcher. Compatible with biof3-py-runtime scanpy>=1.9.

anndata_file.description: Path to .h5ad file (relative to jobDir or absolute). Must exist and be >1KB.

min_genes.description: sc.pp.filter_cells(min_genes) threshold; cells with fewer genes are dropped.

min_cells.description: sc.pp.filter_genes(min_cells) threshold; genes detected in fewer cells are dropped.

n_top_genes.description: sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(n_top_genes) — number of HVGs to flag.

leiden_key.description: obs column key under which Leiden labels are stored.

method.description: sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(method) — statistical test for marker genes.
